# MO EHAB ADS — Paid Advertising Specialist
# moehabads.com

## About
Mohamed Ehab is a Paid Ads Specialist with 10+ years of experience in Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and the Gulf region. He manages digital advertising campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, and Twitter/X for e-commerce brands, restaurants, nonprofits, apps, and B2B companies. Also provides influencer marketing management, video production, product photography, and video editing services exclusively in Saudi Arabia.
